description: Normalized geographic entities associated with the initial Gunnlaugs saga prototype.

places.editorial_note: The saga residence called Borg or Burg is identified with the extant historic farm and church site Borg á Mýrum. The coordinates represent the modern site and do not claim to identify the exact position of every medieval structure.

Gufuárós is identified as the mouth of the Gufuá in the Hvítá estuarine system. Modern sources confirm that the lower Gufuá is tidal. Exact geometry is withheld because the appropriate medieval landing or harbor point and historic shoreline have not yet been established.

Scholarly commentary identifies the saga's Valfell with the mountain now called Kambur or Kamburinn. The modern place-name is independently documented in the Tandrasel place-name record. Exact geometry is withheld pending confirmation of the correct mapped landform and the location of the associated Borgfirðingar assembly site.

The Árni Magnússon Institute identifies the Grenjar named in Gunnlaugs saga with the farm historically in Álftaneshrepp and now in Borgarbyggð. The coordinates represent the modern farm location and do not claim that the medieval farm buildings occupied precisely the same point.
